subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text.
stimulus: bangladesh is a small country its main crops are rice jute sugar-cane and tea the main rivers are the padma the jamuna the meghna the karnaphuli the sundarbans rangamati and coxs bazar are very attractive the royal bengal tiger lives in the sundarbans. Part—B: Writing (Marks—40)
guide_solution: Corrected Paragraph with Capitals and Punctuation: Bangladesh is a small country. Its main crops are rice, jute, sugar-cane and tea. The main rivers are the Padma, the Jamuna, the Meghna and the Karnaphuli. The Sundarbans, Rangamati, and Cox’s Bazar are very attractive. The Royal Bengal Tiger lives in the Sundarbans. ● Note: For writing part solution, see the folder name ‘Writing Part’ in Google drive.
